summary: Item 'Training school wins praise for newspaper' reports the Ironsides Echo, monthly student publication of the NJ State Manual Training and Industrial School for Colored Youth in Bordentown, won a second-place award from the Columbia University Scholastic Press Association among technical and agricultural high school papers; page also carries unrelated county political and news items.
